reviewed.subject: Chemistry
reviewed.requirement: Interpret isotopic-abundance spectra or weighted mean

support.front: How is the weighted mean relative atomic mass calculated?
support.back: Sum of (isotopic mass × abundance) divided by total abundance.

support.back: (isotope mass₁×abundance₁ + mass₂×abundance₂) ÷ total abundance.

reviewed.limitation: Weighted mean/isotopic abundance calculation is recalled, but distinguishing spectra peaks and their interpretation is a separate practical/exam application.
